issues: The Fanfare heal amount is encoded incorrectly as {"op":"sourceCost"}, but the card says X equals the cost of the top card put into your EX area. This should be encoded as a sequence that moves the top card to EX area, then heals your leader by that moved card's cost. The needed dynamic amount 'cost of the card moved to EX area / top card of deck just moved' is not implemented in the ability reference and should be added.
Remove the incorrect keyword 'fanfare' from keywords; the source card has only activated abilities and no Fanfare.

The [act] Earth Rite ability is encoded as three separate activated abilities, but the source says to select another follower on your field and give it Rush, Bane, or Drain, meaning one activation should choose exactly one of those three keywords. This should be a single activated ability with an Earth Rite condition using a choose effect with three options that each grant one keyword to the same selected other follower.

The current encoding does not guarantee a single target shared by the chosen keyword option. To represent 'select another follower on your field and give it Rush, Bane, or Drain' correctly, the engine needs support for choosing among keyword grants after selecting one target, or an implemented pattern for 'choose one keyword to grant' tied to one chosen target.
